```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. CASHIER TRAIN DATA

lines_cashier <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/cashier_data.csv", warn = FALSE)

cashier_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines_cashier),
  basket = lines_cashier
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

cashier_long <- cashier_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    price >= 0
  )

# basket-level cashier table
cashier_basket <- cashier_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. CASHIER GRAPH TRAIN

cashier_dept_data <- cashier_long %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

cashier_pairs <- cashier_dept_data %>%
  inner_join(cashier_dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

cashier_dept_counts <- cashier_dept_data %>%
  count(department_name, name = "dept_count")

cashier_pair_counts <- cashier_pairs %>%
  count(dept_1, dept_2, name = "pair_count")

cashier_pair_conditional <- cashier_pair_counts %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_dept_counts %>% rename(dept_1 = department_name, dept_1_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_dept_counts %>% rename(dept_2 = department_name, dept_2_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_2_given_1 = pair_count / dept_1_count,
    p_1_given_2 = pair_count / dept_2_count,
    conditional_strength = (p_2_given_1 + p_1_given_2) / 2,
    conditional_rarity = -log(conditional_strength)
  )

cashier_graph_train <- cashier_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_pair_conditional %>%
      select(dept_1, dept_2, conditional_strength, conditional_rarity),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cashier_graph_score = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_avg_conditional_strength = mean(conditional_strength, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_n_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. CASHIER MARKOV TRAIN

cashier_transitions <- cashier_long %>%
  arrange(transaction_id, item_order) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(next_department = lead(department_name)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_department)) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    from_dept = department_name,
    to_dept = next_department
  )

cashier_transition_counts <- cashier_transitions %>%
  count(from_dept, to_dept, name = "transition_count")

cashier_from_counts <- cashier_transitions %>%
  count(from_dept, name = "from_count")

cashier_transition_probs <- cashier_transition_counts %>%
  left_join(cashier_from_counts, by = "from_dept") %>%
  mutate(
    transition_prob = transition_count / from_count,
    transition_neglog = -log(transition_prob)
  )

cashier_markov_train <- cashier_transitions %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_transition_probs %>%
      select(from_dept, to_dept, transition_prob, transition_neglog),
    by = c("from_dept", "to_dept")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cashier_markov_score = mean(transition_neglog, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_avg_transition_prob = mean(transition_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_n_transitions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# optional: top cashier anomalies relative to cashier norm
cashier_combo_train <- cashier_basket %>%
  left_join(cashier_graph_train, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  left_join(cashier_markov_train, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cashier_graph_score = replace_na(cashier_graph_score, 0),
    cashier_markov_score = replace_na(cashier_markov_score, 0),
    cashier_graph_score_01 = percent_rank(cashier_graph_score),
    cashier_markov_score_01 = percent_rank(cashier_markov_score),
    cashier_graph_markov_score =
      0.5 * cashier_graph_score_01 +
      0.5 * cashier_markov_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(cashier_graph_markov_score))

top_150_cashier_graph_markov_train <- cashier_combo_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

write.csv(
  top_150_cashier_graph_markov_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_cashier_graph_markov_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 4. SUPERMARKET DATA TO SCORE

lines_supermarket <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines_supermarket),
  basket = lines_supermarket
)

supermarket_long <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

supermarket_basket <- supermarket_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. APPLY CASHIER GRAPH TO SUPERMARKET

supermarket_dept_data <- supermarket_long %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

supermarket_pairs <- supermarket_dept_data %>%
  inner_join(supermarket_dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

supermarket_graph_from_cashier <- supermarket_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_pair_conditional %>%
      select(dept_1, dept_2, conditional_strength, conditional_rarity),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cashier_graph_score = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_avg_conditional_strength = mean(conditional_strength, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_n_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 6. APPLY CASHIER MARKOV TO SUPERMARKET

supermarket_transitions <- supermarket_long %>%
  arrange(transaction_id, item_order) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(next_department = lead(department_name)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_department)) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    from_dept = department_name,
    to_dept = next_department
  )

supermarket_markov_from_cashier <- supermarket_transitions %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_transition_probs %>%
      select(from_dept, to_dept, transition_prob, transition_neglog),
    by = c("from_dept", "to_dept")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cashier_markov_score = mean(transition_neglog, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_avg_transition_prob = mean(transition_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    cashier_n_transitions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 7. FINAL CASHIER GRAPH + MARKOV SCORE

supermarket_cashier_combo <- supermarket_basket %>%
  left_join(supermarket_graph_from_cashier, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  left_join(supermarket_markov_from_cashier, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cashier_graph_score = replace_na(cashier_graph_score, 0),
    cashier_markov_score = replace_na(cashier_markov_score, 0),
    cashier_graph_score_01 = percent_rank(cashier_graph_score),
    cashier_markov_score_01 = percent_rank(cashier_markov_score),
    cashier_graph_markov_score =
      0.5 * cashier_graph_score_01 +
      0.5 * cashier_markov_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(cashier_graph_markov_score))

top_150_supermarket_from_cashier_graph_markov <- supermarket_cashier_combo %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

write.csv(
  top_150_supermarket_from_cashier_graph_markov,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_supermarket_from_cashier_graph_markov.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
